goal: Open the Batch Name lookup/list on Fixed Asset G/L Journals without selecting or changing a value, then capture visible list/options as evidence.

triggeredBy.decision: Lookup buttons are not value proof; next smallest useful evidence is a no-select lookup-list probe.

acceptanceCriteria: Business Central remains in MCP_1_20260210 / RM-DEMO.
Batch Name lookup/list is opened only if it can be done without selecting a value.
Visible lookup/list options or blocked reason are captured.
No Batch Name value is selected or changed.
No journal line is created, edited or deleted.
No Calculate Depreciation OK, Preview Posting, Post, setup change, company switch or API shortcut occurs.
stopConditions: Instance or company is not explicit.
A lookup click would select a value immediately.
A list item becomes selected or a field value changes.
The diagnosis would require typing into Batch Name or pressing Enter.
nextSafeAction: Implement and run FA-285 as a no-select lookup-list probe; do not select a batch, confirm OK, Preview Posting or Post.
